title: Nine Years of Finding
subtitle: 厨师与烹饪 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 厨师与烹饪（生活与学习·饮食与烹饪）
meta: 主题语境：厨师与烹饪（生活与学习·饮食与烹饪）　|　核心词汇：chef　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 chef 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 my mother was sent to find ① chef she could not pay, and she said the finding was the whole of the lesson. The ② chef, meaning the cook and not the kitchen, was nine years trained and was found by whoever came last; chef, she said, is the only thing in a hotel that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ chef in that hotel had the same knife, and the ④ chef at the end, meaning the one the owner kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever found properly. Chef, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ chef was the whole of the dinner, meaning the craft it carried and not the cook. The ⑥ chef, meaning the craft and not any of that, is the only thing in a dinner that everybody praises and nobody questions; chef, he said, is either something you find or the only word that means both a cook and a craft. She said the craft is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ chef had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the knife. The ⑧ chef of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine years and eleven years of finding; chef, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ chef I remember is the one at the end, which was found in 1976 and is still described as the finest in the county. A ⑩ chef, my grandmother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being found; every chef, she said, is a craft that has agreed to look like a cook. She said the craft was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 厨师（指那位厨子本身，与那间厨房相对）
C. 固定搭配：find a chef 找到一位厨师
D. n. 厨师（指那家旅馆里每一位）
E. n. 厨师（指末尾那一位）
F. n. 手艺（抽象：它承载的那门技艺）
G. n. 那门技艺（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The chef, meaning the cook and not the kitchen
chef was the whole of the dinner
the chef had become a number in a report
The chef of the whole thing
A chef, my grandmother said in 1981

answers.why: find a chef 意为“找到一位厨师”，1956 年母亲被派去找她付不起工钱的那位厨师。
chef 意为“厨师、主厨”，指那位厨子本身而不是那间厨房，学了九年，由最后来的人找到。
chef 指那家旅馆里每一位厨师，每一位都是同样的刀。
chef 指末尾那一位（老板留下的那一位），是唯一有人认真找过的。
chef 意为“手艺”，抽象指它承载的那门技艺，父亲说 chef 就是那顿饭的全部。
chef 为抽象用法，指那门技艺本身，是一顿饭里人人都称赞、却没人质疑的东西。
chef 意为“厨师、主厨”，到 1971 年这位 chef 成了报告里的一个数字。
chef 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年与十一年的寻找。
chef 意为“厨师”，我记得的是末尾那一位，1976 年找到，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
chef 为抽象总称，祖母说一位厨师是唯一会因为被认真寻找而变好的东西。
